name: web__search
description: Search the live web using the configured search service, independently of the conversation model. Returns source titles, URLs, snippets and available publication dates; fetch selected URLs to read the source. Credentials stay in the host.

query.description: Search terms; supports site:, quoted phrases, lang:, after: and before:.

name: web__fetch
description: Read a source webpage as paged Markdown. The host requests the page directly first (public addresses only; HTML is converted to Markdown, Markdown and text pass through) and asks the search service's crawler only when that is blocked or fails, so reading a page needs no search credential. Returns url, title, content, provider, retrieved_at, snapshot_id, char_offset, returned_chars, total_chars, complete and next_cursor. If incomplete, call again with the same URL and cursor=next_cursor to read the unchanged snapshot without another network fetch. WEB_PAGE_NOT_FOUND means the site itself said the page does not exist; WEB_PAGE_UNAVAILABLE means neither fetcher could read it and the page may still exist, so browser.open can try it in a real browser. Unread text is not evidence.

url.description: HTTP(S) source URL without embedded credentials.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page. Omit for a fresh network fetch.
